notes: Leg kicks and an overhand right set up a power takedown.
Finished with ground strikes 34 seconds in.

rounds.summary: Wint landed leg kicks, Adams clinched and tried a trip, and Wint reversed it and finished with ground and pound at 0:34.

notes: Constant forward pressure and takedown attempts won two judges.
Escarrega defended most takedowns; one judge had it a 30-27 shutout for him.
Round-by-round (DK Network, MMA News): Escarrega won all three rounds, dropping Alsaghir and stuffing 15 takedowns. The split for Alsaghir looks like a robbery; treat it as a weak win.

rounds.summary: Alsaghir pressed wildly; Escarrega clinched, landed the harder punches and (per MMA News) dropped Alsaghir with a punch to the head. DK Network scored it 10-9 Escarrega.
Alsaghir kept shooting and kept failing (MMA News: 14 straight stuffed across two rounds); Escarrega landed a knee first thought to be illegal. DK Network 10-9 Escarrega.
Escarrega controlled Alsaghir on the ground for most of the round and threatened a D'Arce; Alsaghir's desperation submissions went nowhere. DK Network 10-9 Escarrega (30-27).

recap.note: Both round-by-round sources had Escarrega winning every round; the judges gave Alsaghir a split (29-28, 29-28, 27-30). DK stats: Alsaghir 0 of 15 takedowns, Escarrega 82-48 significant strikes, 3 takedowns, 5:02 control.

notes: Caught a leg kick and dropped Saikia with an overhand right.
Quick follow-up strikes on the ground ended it.

rounds.summary: Hasan opened with leg kicks, dropped Saikia with a right hand within seconds and finished with a barrage of punches at 0:45.

notes: Blended striking and wrestling, building momentum each round.
Late R3 takedown, then elbows from side control for the stoppage.
Pagliarulo was hurt twice and lost R1 (DK Network), then came back with takedowns and ground strikes to finish in R3.

rounds.summary: Both were dropped early (MMA News); Mulumba then hurt Pagliarulo again with a left hand. Pagliarulo got a takedown with under two minutes left but couldn't keep him down. DK Network 10-9 Mulumba.
Pagliarulo raised his output with punches, leg kicks, knees and elbows while Mulumba became stationary. DK Network: likely Pagliarulo's round.
Mulumba landed a big punch, but Pagliarulo took him down again and finished with ground and pound (elbows from side control) at 4:24.

notes: Controlled range with jab, straight shots and teeps.
Nearly finished an armbar late in R3.

rounds.summary: Kunneman opened with aggressive punching but lower output; Kropschot answered with leg kicks, clinches and sharp counters. DK Network 10-9 Kropschot.
Kropschot got an early takedown but Kunneman escaped, and Kunneman appeared to hurt Kropschot late. DK Network 10-9 Kunneman.
Competitive early; Kunneman took him down, Kropschot reversed to top and threatened an armbar late. DK Network 10-9 Kropschot; MMA News had Kropschot in control throughout.

recap.note: Judges 30-27, 30-27, 29-28. DK stats: significant strikes 119-59 Kropschot.
